name: Tuesday Tap-Out
schedule: Every Tuesday, year-round, wheels rolling 6:30 pm sharp from Regions Bank on Main St in East Point. The group won't wait for latecomers.
pace: Group A 19+ mph average, Group B 17–18 mph
visitor_notes: Arrive early; the start is sharp. The club suggests downloading the route to your GPS if you doubt you can hold the pace. The club's winter route (35 miles) is used from the time change until the Tuesday after daylight saving time begins; lights needed for the dark months.
description: MACC's weekly Tuesday night road ride out of East Point, about 29 miles on the club's route with A and B groups and several regroup spots. In the standard-time months the club swaps in a 35-mile winter route toward Palmetto. A good first club ride if you can hold 17 mph.
evidence: MACC's own calendar lists the ride for Tue Oct 6, 13, 20, 27 and Nov 3, 2026 at 6:30 pm from 2833 Main St, East Point; the event's feed is a weekly rule (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Per-event iCal feed on the club's WordPress calendar. The club lists a longer winter route (35 miles, south on Hwy 29 to Palmetto) until the Tuesday after daylight saving time begins.

name: Thursday Tango
schedule: Every Thursday, wheels rolling 6:30 pm from Regions Bank on Main St in East Point. A training ride, 26 miles.
visitor_notes: The club lists this as a drop ride and a training ride. Download the route first if you doubt you can hold the pace.
description: A quick-pace Thursday training ride from MACC, 26 miles at 19 to 21 mph. The club files it as a drop ride, so it is not the one for a first group ride. Same start as the Tuesday Tap-Out.
evidence: MACC's own calendar lists the ride for Thu Oct 1, 8, 15, 22, 29, 2026 at 6:30 pm, category Drop Ride; the event's feed is a weekly rule (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Per-event iCal feed on the club's WordPress calendar.

name: Beginner / Casual Ride
schedule: Second Saturday of the month, wheels rolling 9:00 am from Peters St near the U-Haul, southwest Atlanta. Arrive at least 20 minutes early.
pace: Beginner and casual pace; 18-mile and 28-mile options
visitor_notes: Aimed at beginners who want to try a group on city streets instead of the Silver Comet or Arabia Mountain trails. Arrive 20 minutes early.
description: A monthly city-street group ride for people new to riding in a group, with an 18-mile and a 28-mile option toward Hwy 29. The club says no one will be left behind. The calendar also lists a pre-ride at 7:00 am from the same spot.
evidence: MACC's calendar lists the ride for Sat Oct 10, 2026 at 9:00 am and its feed repeats it on the second Saturday of each month (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Per-event iCal feed: repeats on the 2nd Saturday monthly.

name: Thursday Night Rocks (Gravel)

start_location.name: SCDOT lot, Ogden Rd and Robertson Rd
start_location.address: 338 W Robertson Rd, Rock Hill, SC 29730

visitor_notes: Club recommends 35 to 38 mm tires (the home page says 38 mm or wider). It will be getting dark by the end of October; bring lights.
description: A Thursday evening gravel ride on Rock Hill's rural roads, about 25 miles, half hardpack gravel and half rural pavement. Three pace groups from 14 to 20 mph. The club calls it a drop ride.
evidence: The club's RideWithGPS events show Thursday Night Rocks for Oct 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29, 2026 at 6:00 pm, and the club's home page lists it as a drop ride (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: RWGPS org 12871 lists each Thursday as its own event. The club's description says every other week through the summer.

name: Tucker (TUK)

pace: Race pace; A, B and C groups
